description: Interactive viewer for code_aster .med results: fields, time steps, deformed shape, plane cuts, Gauss points and journal figures.
config.executable: The `aster-view` command. With the default value it is searched in `PATH`, `~/.local/bin`, virtual environments in `~/venvs` (also `~/.venvs`, `~/.virtualenvs`, `~/venv`) and conda environments; set the full path if it lives somewhere else (e.g. `/home/me/venvs/aster/bin/aster-view`).
config.openIn.vscode: In a VS Code tab (Aster View editor).
config.language.auto: The language last chosen in the viewer; the first time, the VS Code display language.
